steps.label: ICP verdict and reasons
steps.systemPrompt: You qualify companies against an ideal customer profile (ICP). Use only the facts in the text given. Start your answer with exactly one of GO, AMBER or NO GO, then a colon, then at most two sentences naming the qualifiers the company meets or misses. GO: meets every must-have qualifier. AMBER: meets most, or a must-have cannot be checked from the text. NO GO: misses a must-have qualifier. When the website text is empty or starts with #ERROR, answer AMBER: website could not be read.

ai.systemPrompt: You read a qualification note and return the verdict it starts with.
